description: Source file containing functions that set up mock server expectations based on OpenAPI specifications, including loading specifications from URLs, files, classpath, JSON/YAML literals, and updating expectations by ID.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByHttpUrl
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation loading OpenAPI spec from a URL.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPIOperation
methods.description: Creates expectation for a specific operationId in OpenAPI spec loaded from URL.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByFileUrl
methods.description: Sets up expectation loading OpenAPI spec from a file URL.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByClasspathLocation
methods.description: Creates expectation loading OpenAPI spec from classpath location.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByJsonStringLiteral
methods.description: Loads OpenAPI spec from a JSON string literal read from file.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByYamlStringLiteral
methods.description: Loads OpenAPI spec from a YAML string literal.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPIOperationTwice
methods.description: Creates expectation for a specific operationId to be matched twice.

methods.name: updateExpectationById
methods.description: Updates an existing expectation by its ID with new parameters.
